suggested_requirements.text: The ELSS must capture all data necessary for recording the fishing activities undertaken by a UK fishing vessel.
The ELSS must output the data as an XML file for transmission to the UK fisheries administrations’ ERS system.
The ELSS must validate data against the UK XML/XSD before transmission from the fishing vessel.
The ELSS must transmit data at the required times set out in Section 2.5.1.
The ELSS must provide data capture screens for the entry of the logbook, transhipment and landing declaration data.
The ELSS must use English (UK) localizations for all UK Electronic Logbook features.
The ELSS must provide the ability to print out the ELSS logbook data using an onboard printer.
The ELSS must protect electronic print files so that they cannot be modified once generated and distributed.
The ELSS must provide facilities to capture and deliver corrections to previously successfully transmitted data.
The ELSS must provide facilities to transmit deletions to previously transmitted data.
The ELSS must be able to receive acknowledgement (RET) messages transmitted from the UK fisheries administrations’ ERS system.
The ELSS must match each acknowledgement message with the appropriate transmitted data operation, deletion or correction report.
The ELSS must retain all logbook reports and any corrections on the system at least until the end of each trip.
All xml documents attached to emails to the UK fisheries administrations’ ERS system must be encrypted using PGP.
The ELSS must provide one username/password for the owner of each vessel.
The ELSS must allow the owner to set up subsidiary users with their own username and password.
The ELSS must record the username in each report completed and in each transmission made.
All dates and times must be UTC.
Each ELSS data transmission will be acknowledged by a return message from the UK fisheries administrations’ ERS system.
